title: Antimicrobial activity of compound VG1: Part-II
abstract: In earlier paper, the synthesis of  (benzamide derivative) was reported. The antimicrobial activity of has been reported in part-II in continuation of part-I synthesis of the VG1. The compound was evaluated at single dose of 20nmoles in the antimicrobial screening. The mixture of microbial culture was evaluated against the The process involved standard, vehicle and control. The standard being Brand X disinfectant, control being Water and vehicle being ethanol. Test being the compound VG1 dissolved in ethanol, 20nmoles in strength and being evaluated.
